highlights: Add OpenRouter or DeepSeek as a provider with an API key, and choose their models for your agents.
Agents use the skills in your ~/.agents/skills folder with every provider. Type $ in the message box to tag one.
On a Mac, connect Apple apps from the Apps catalog, so agents can use Mail, Calendar, Notes, Messages and more.
Paste an image into the message box at the cursor, and zoom into images in a chat.
Codex, Claude on Windows and the Linux AppImage on Arch Linux start and keep working again.
